visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with vibrant pink hair and a blue knitted sweater is sitting on a sofa in a brightly lit room with bookshelves. He uses a black marker to draw a small solid dot on the back of his hand while smiling at the camera. (2) He points his smartphone's camera and flash directly at the black dot and triggers a photo. Immediately after the flash, he jumps back with an exaggerated expression of shock, holding his hand. (3) The scene cuts to him with a friend in a black and white jacket. He draws a dot on the friend's arm and uses the phone flash, but the friend has no reaction, leading to a comedic 'fail' moment. (4) He repeats the experiment with a second friend in a grey suit. This friend reacts dramatically to the flash, pulling his arm away quickly. (5) He continues with a third and fourth friend, drawing larger dots. One guest reacts with confusion while the other finally reports a burning sensation, causing the host to laugh and celebrate the successful reaction. (6) The final sequence shows the host with his brother in a white sweater; they joke about burning a mole off, and when the flash fires, the brother reacts strongly to the heat, shouting 'So hot!' while the host laughs joyfully.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, quirky electronic BGM with a strong drum machine beat starts immediately. A high-pitched male voice speaks rapidly and with high arousal, punctuated by 'boing' and 'pop' cartoon sound effects. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound (phone flash) is followed by a dramatic 'whoosh' and a comedic orchestral hit. The male host yells out in mock surprise, followed by bright laughter. (3) The audio track becomes fragmented with quick cuts as different male voices interact. Each transition is marked by a percussive 'ding' or 'swish'. The BGM remains energetic throughout, ducking only slightly to allow clear dialogue. (4) Loud cheering and high-pitched laughter from several men occur after a specific test, accented by a 'sparkle' SFX. (5) The final phase features a loud exclamation of 'Hot!' with high vocal tension, followed by a triumphant musical flourish and more laughter as the video ends.
